name: LOG
desc: Covers the LOG action: info/warn continuation, fail termination with NO_MATCH, literal named/numeric levels and numeric action ID, value-context messages/data and scope, printable Unicode and forbidden codepoints, argument evaluation failures, lazy action branches, and syntax. Portable fixtures assert output/errors and the complete ordered logs, including optional data snapshots and fatal entries. Delivery, collection layout, and diagnostic paths remain implementation-specific. Invalid literal messages fail with INVALID_GRAFT. Invalid message expression results fail with INVALID_TARGET, with the usual static-upgrade rules. Invalid literal levels and arities are INVALID_GRAFT.

tests.name: Levels and execution
tests.desc: Levels are literal info/warn/fail or 0/1/2. Informational/warning actions preserve the current data and permit following actions; fail always terminates the attempt with NO_MATCH after evaluating its arguments.

tests.name: Messages and data
tests.desc: Message and optional data evaluate in value context at the current node. References and namespaces supply data rather than reinterpreted expression syntax. Data may contain controls, noncharacters, or lone surrogates even though messages may not.

tests.name: Message types and evaluation failures
tests.desc: Evaluated messages must be strings. Runtime message/data errors propagate, including at fail level, rather than being replaced with NO_MATCH. A failed argument does not execute subsequent actions.

tests.name: Forbidden message codepoints
tests.desc: Messages reject every C0/C1 control, DEL, lone surrogate codepoint, U+FDD0..FDEF, and the last two codepoints of each Unicode plane. Supplementary scalar values are permitted; UTF-16 code units belonging to a valid pair are not individual surrogate codepoints. Prefix/suffix probes ensure validation scans the entire message.

tests.name: Invalid literal messages
tests.desc: Invalid literal message types and literal forbidden text are intrinsic graft errors. Constant expressions are still expressions and may fail at runtime with INVALID_TARGET or be rejected statically.

tests.name: Branches and argument validation
tests.desc: Only selected IF actions execute LOG. Level is a literal and is not evaluated, even when an expression would produce a valid level. Structurally malformed skipped actions may be diagnosed by static validation.

tests.name: Recorded snapshots and partial failures
tests.desc: Logs are observed even after runtime failure. Message order, optional data, and snapshots are checked separately from the final tree; later edits must not rewrite earlier data. Static INVALID_GRAFT rejection may occur before execution, so log expectations do not apply to that outcome.

tests.name: A prior record survives data failure
